name: The Meridian Atrocity Files
description: An anonymous documentary assembled from stolen internal footage, whistleblower testimony, and intercepted corporate communications, cataloging fourteen separate incidents of corponation-sanctioned mass displacement, medical experimentation on uncontracted Shelf residents, and deliberate infrastructure sabotage between 2181 and 2192. The film names specific executives and provides coordinates for mass graves beneath three Meridian 88 construction sites. No studio or director is credited; it arrived simultaneously on seventeen pirate mesh nodes.
cultural_impact: The film catalyzed the formation of the Shelf Documentation Network and permanently altered the risk calculus for corporate whistleblowers — either making them more bold or more careful, depending on whom you ask.
story_hooks: A runner is offered an extraordinary sum to deliver a physical drive containing what their client claims is a sequel — updated files covering 2193 to present.
One of the construction sites named in the film is being excavated for a new Tier 4 development; the bones are about to become impossible to ignore.
The film's anonymous creators are being hunted by a corporate intelligence unit — and one of them is someone the players already know.
